plugin.name: No Voice (Instant)
plugin.description: No spoken activation line and no pre-freeze delay. The time-stop and resume sound effects remain enabled.

plugin.name: DIO Brando
plugin.description: Uses dio_activation.wav as the complete activation cue. The shared time-stop and resume effects remain unchanged.

plugin.name: Jotaro Kujo
plugin.description: Uses jotaro_activation.wav as the complete activation cue. The shared time-stop and resume effects remain unchanged.

plugin.name: Recommended
plugin.description: The intended balanced experience. Powerful time stop with limited duration and resource consumption. Maximum 10 seconds, 12 AP per second, 20-second cooldown, AP regeneration disabled, and manual early deactivation enabled.

plugin.name: Challenging
plugin.description: Shorter time stops, higher AP consumption, and longer recovery. Intended for players seeking a greater challenge. Maximum 5 seconds, 18 AP per second, 30-second cooldown, AP regeneration disabled, and manual early deactivation enabled.

plugin.name: Extended
plugin.description: Longer time stops, reduced AP consumption, and shorter recovery. A more powerful experience. Maximum 20 seconds, 6 AP per second, 10-second cooldown, AP regeneration disabled, and manual early deactivation enabled.

plugin.name: Unlimited
plugin.description: Unrestricted time stop. Activate and deactivate whenever you want, with no duration, AP cost, or cooldown. Timer, resource restrictions, AP-regeneration restriction, and automatic expiration are explicitly disabled.
